name: SDList
description: Paged, batch-buffered list that offloads elements to SD card or LittleFS using binary storage. Any trivially-copyable type (int, float, struct) is stored without text serialisation, eliminating data corruption. A fixed in-memory batch window keeps RAM predictable while a pre-allocated file prevents fragmentation.

changes: Complete rewrite: binary storage replaces text serialisation, eliminating data corruption for all trivially-copyable types.
Fixed batch window: one pre-allocated T[BATCH_SIZE] buffer, never reallocated.
Pre-allocated file with grow-on-demand: no fragmentation.
set() method added for direct element overwrite.
insert() and remove() now correctly shift elements in binary mode.
SDListMode enum replaces Mode enum to avoid name collisions.
Reimplemented using ArrayList for in-memory storage.
